issue.title: Ctrl+Shift+Alt+B opens the Blocks… stage, Ctrl+Shift+B in reverse
issue.description: In Obsidian, Ctrl+Shift+Alt+B on task N (Task Card ⇧B) opens a Blocks… stage where Bryan picks the open tasks T that N blocks. Applying it writes N onto each T's Depends-On line. The bytes are exactly what Ctrl+Shift+B on T adding N would write: T becomes Blocked, its live links in today's Pomodoros are consumed, N takes over its lane, and N's BLOCKS mirror is updated. The stage previews every consequence before ↵, and BLOCKS chips gain ＋ / ×.
